prose: Daring Fireball quotes a Truth Social post in which President Trump says the White House considers anyone who uses the term Artificial Intelligence, instead of what he calls the more accurate Super Intelligence, to be the enemy. Gruber presents it as an actual post from a sitting president and invites readers to check in on the blog.
The excerpt gives the post and the commentary framing only. The Techmeme entry for the same post appeared the day before.
highlights: Trump post says to say Super Intelligence, not Artificial Intelligence
Calls those who do not the enemy
Gruber frames it as a real presidential post
